notes: Two instruments: the bilateral convention and the multilateral UMA convention (signed 23-07-1990; DGI header: WHT effective 01/01/94). UMA Art. 29(3): 'Les dispositions de la présente Convention se substituent aux dispositions prévues par les Conventions bilatérales' (bilaterals revive only if a State withdraws), so the UMA convention governs. Neither instrument sets a source-State cap: UMA Art. 11(1) dividends 'sont imposables dans l'Etat d'où proviennent les bénéfices distribués et selon la législation de l'Etat d'où proviennent ces bénéfices'; Art. 12(1) interest 'imposables dans l'Etat où sont payés lesdits intérêts', residence State exempts or credits; Art. 13(1) royalties 'ne sont imposables que dans l'Etat cité en premier lieu' (source State only). The bilateral text read gives the same source-only rules (Algeria 1985: Art. 10(1) dividends taxable in the payer's State under its law; Art. 11(1) interest taxable where paid; Art. 12(1) royalties taxable in the first (source) State). All three categories omitted (source State taxes under domestic law without treaty limit). MLI: map records no coverage for this pair (Tunisia lists both the bilateral and UMA; partner side not matched) - PPT not asserted. Bilateral text: https://jibaya.tn/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Algerie.pdf PPT: not applied - Algeria is not an MLI Party (map); UMA coverage not matched.
